scope: Wave-2 delta audit of the ur values for the 45 keys new in en since merge-base c092a74b45 (ui.chat.run_details, ui.chat.trace, ui.common.time). Checked meaning, completeness, ICU validity with a python ICU parser (placeholder sets, select/plural arms, one/other per ur CLDR), gender/number agreement (ذیلی ایجنٹ masc per ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_children; جاب fem per ui.chat.run_controls.job.cancel_failed), renders at 0,1,2,5,21,1000000, glossary, bidi (no control characters; runtime isolation src/i18n/bidi.ts:131-147, src/i18n/messages.ts:242-249), and that the ur diff is additions only. Existing values are context, not re-audited.

minor.finding: Length/glossary: every arm reads 'درمیان میں روکا گیا / روکی گئی' (four words) where the context asks for one or two words beside the row name, and the existing ur glossary renders 'interrupted' as 'روکی گئی' (ui.chat.canonical.transcript.interrupted, ui.chat.canonical.notice.interrupted, ui.chat.canonical.tool_row.outcome.interrupted). Meaning and gender agreement are correct (subagent masc, job fem), so non-gating. Suggestion: subagent/other 'روکا گیا', job 'روکی گئی', and in ui.chat.run_details.tally.interrupted '# روکا گیا/# روکے گئے' and '# روکی گئی/# روکی گئیں'; still distinct from paused 'رکا ہوا/رکی ہوئی'. Disposition: optional polish, may be deferred.

nit.finding: '{duration} سے کم' uses words where the context asks for a terse symbol-like reading in a narrow right-aligned column (tool-row.tsx:804-809, a shrink-0 span, so the extra ~5 characters take width from the row label rather than truncating). Defensible: it avoids a mirrored '<' next to an FSI-isolated Latin duration in RTL, and reads correctly once isolated (src/i18n/bidi.ts:131-147 via src/i18n/messages.ts:242-249). Disposition: keep; noted only for width.

'پہلے {count}' is idiomatic for 'first N', but 'پہلے' also means 'before', and the sibling ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.before is '{id} سے پہلے' in the same row family. 'ابتدائی {count}' would be unambiguous. Disposition: optional.
